product_overview: A fast, interactive portfolio website for Rishi Saha that showcases work, enables region-aware pricing, supports theme switching, and lets visitors send business inquiries directly from the site. The experience is enhanced with visual effects, a custom cursor, and live footer metrics.
core_goals: Browse a portfolio website with an engaging visual presentation
Adjust displayed pricing and budget options by selecting a country and currency
Switch between dark and light visual themes
Submit a business inquiry through the website contact form

features.name: Country & Currency Selector
features.description: Visitors can choose a country and currency so pricing hints and budget options match their region.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open the country selector -> Choose a country and currency -> See the header flag and currency label update -> See the hero price hint update -> See the contact form budget options update

features.name: Brutalist Theme Toggle
features.description: Visitors can switch the site between Obsidian Dark and Blinding Light themes.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Toggle the theme switch -> See the site styling change to the alternate theme -> Toggle the theme switch again -> See the site styling return to the original theme

features.name: Lead Contact Form
features.description: Potential clients can complete and submit a business inquiry from the portfolio site.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Fill in the name -> Fill in the email -> Select a budget tier -> Write the message -> Submit the contact form -> See the success overlay

features.name: Country and Currency Selector
features.description: Selecting a country/currency updates price hints and project budgets across the website.
user_interactions: Click on the country selector button.
Click on a country in the dropdown list (e.g., USA).
Check if the flag and currency label update on the button.
Verify that the price hint in the hero section updates (e.g., $1,000).
Verify that the budget options in the contact form update.

features.name: Brutalist Theme Toggle
features.description: Toggles between Obsidian Dark theme and Blinding Light theme.
user_interactions: Click the Brutalist Theme Toggle switch.
Verify the theme changes by checking classes on the HTML element.

features.name: Lead Contact Form
features.description: Submits business inquiries via Web3Forms or launches mailto fallback.
user_interactions: Fill in name in the name input field.
Fill in email in the email input field.
Select a budget tier from the dropdown.
Fill in the message text area.
Verify the transmission success overlay appears.
